goal: Unblock Android candidate packaging and reconcile CI readiness using a separate dependency installation and reviewed candidate composition, without cloud activation or secret access.
successCriteria: Materialize an exact-byte copy of the frozen v4 source into a new checkout without shared dependency junctions or private files.
Install lockfile dependencies with a supported Node LTS, lifecycle scripts disabled, no account config or backend credentials, and verify source hashes before and after.
Run current checks plus actual Metro web and Android embedded exports; record actual bundle hashes and every failure without waiving release gates.
Prepare or implement reviewed candidate-only historical-plan custody and active integration records covering all real deltas; preserve root plans, v4 and the governance checker.
Align quality-workflow Node LTS only after local checks on the selected runtime; keep remote CI, signed-native and cloud acceptance distinct.
Verify safe Vercel Git metadata when Owner login is available; no push, deployment, credential rotation, SQL or store publication.
untouchedSurfaces: All mobile, Admin and backend product runtime, prompts, content, SQL, authentication, credits and user data.
Root Git index/history, previous v4 files and receipts, all old feature-plan bytes and release allowlist/migration policy.

impact.entryPoint: Owner requested next Android release step after key guidance; local candidate tooling and read-only account metadata.
impact.dataWrite: New ignored dependency/cache/source copy, sanitized receipts and owner report; reviewed quality-workflow Node version only. Historical active-plan disposition occurs only in the new candidate with per-record custody hashes.
impact.backendContract: No API/database contract changes, provider calls, deployment or retarget. Canonical Singapore remains gated; legacy runtime bindings are preserved.
impact.adminVisibility: Sanitized preparation results and current CI/Vercel access blockers only; no Admin config or raw logs/user content.
impact.privacySafety: Never read env/key/session/profile values. Copy only v4 allowlisted bytes, reject links/secrets, blank npm configs and whitelist child environment; no lifecycle scripts or external Git dependencies.
impact.observability: Pin source commit/inventory, lockfile, Node/npm versions, install receipt, per-command results, output hashes and plan-adoption mapping. Local PASS is not remote/native/release evidence.
impact.rollback: Preserve original checkout and previous candidate; create new noncolliding output directories. Stop on drift, unexpected package registry/source, missing integrity or authority need; retain failed logs instead of removing evidence.

canonicalContracts: Use source-candidate-v4.json digest d69a6fb34a6bed121c6efb3e2ae5fda409e763aa9cd29728c6c54656dba8d524 and commit 5b3c438fa859db75b55e487ee4668d4e516f6d7a as immutable input provenance, not release approval.
Keep feature-preflight semantics and original comparison base unchanged; no hash-only refresh, blanket scope or hidden old-record failures.
release-profile target allowlist stays empty and migration-ledger stays blocked; no secret loading, SQL or publish authority.

skillReview.evidence: Read current skill, expanded reference and release-control. Preparation must preserve gates, exact evidence, secret custody and separate source versus cloud/native acceptance; no skill-policy change needed.

dependencyReview.evidence: Expo54.0.35/RN0.81 lock retained; SDK54 minimum Node20.19.4. Official Node schedule marks20/25 EOL and24 LTS. Bundled Node24.19.0 available. Fresh npm ci --ignore-scripts --no-audit --no-fund; no dependency upgrades, inherited credentials, shared package junctions or install hooks.

externalSourceReview.reason: SDK54 minimum Node20.19.4 and monorepo dependency/autolinking behavior; keep source Metro configuration unchanged for clean-install verification.
Official release support: Node24 is LTS; existing local25 and CI20 are EOL, so verify24 before quality-workflow alignment.

securityReview.authzRls: No runtime Auth/RLS edits or cloud SQL. Known Auth/route/budget activation blockers remain explicit and cannot be cleared by local build success.
securityReview.sensitiveData: Explicit v4 file list only. No browser profiles, env files, private keys, actual user data or history blob checkout.
securityReview.secretsLogging: Child process receives system-only allowlisted environment plus fixed nonsecret build settings. npm user/global configs empty; logs limited to public package fetch/build/check output.
securityReview.externalInput: Pinned inventory and lockfile with integrity. Reject external file/Git/credential-bearing package resolutions; no arbitrary user-supplied commands, shell evaluation or source URLs.
securityReview.dependencies: Install exactly the lockfile into a new checkout. Disable lifecycle scripts, audit and funding network; use only public HTTPS npm registry and supported bundled Node24. No upgrades or shared root cache mutation.
securityReview.migrationRelease: No root Git mutation, migration ledger repair, release allowlist changes, signing credential loading or publishing. Historical-plan reconciliation keeps bytes in custody and checker semantics unchanged.
securityReview.stopCondition: Stop on source/hash/lockfile drift, package provenance mismatch, unexpected scripts/secret demand or missing authority. Keep failed/export/CI readiness BLOCKED until actual reviewed evidence passes.

workingTreeReview.note: Reviewed current preparation artifacts and existing quality-workflow changes by exact current hashes; root dirty work and old candidate remain untouched.

validationCommands: Fresh lockfile npm ci with --ignore-scripts --no-audit --no-fund in the new source copy, never in root or v4
Current-record preflight, mobile/admin/web checks and appropriate existing suites using Node24 and isolated dependencies
Expo Metro web export and Android export:embed with EXPO_NO_DOTENV=1 and no backend env
Before-after source and lockfile byte hashes, output artifact hashes and Git status
CI analogue with unchanged checker and original historical base; no fabricated remote CI receipt
managerTestPath: Read the dated report and PASS/BLOCKED matrix; Owner may log into Vercel and verify Play Console account/device directly. No password, key or OTP in chat.
residualRisk: Fresh Windows local build cannot prove Linux remote CI, protected release execution, managed recovery or signed native acceptance. Known runtime cost/Auth gaps remain activation blockers; no public release is authorized.
